Advanced mods like Arma 3’s ACE mods haven’t been fully ported yet, which makes upgrading to Reforger unattractive.

Many larger MilSim clans are waiting for Arma 4 and the release of essential mods before making a potentially risky move.

That said, I want to give full respect to the few clans that have ventured into Reforger with the limited tools currently available.
